newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk shares firm 0.8 pct ahead of censure motion.
newsitem.headline: Turk shares firm 0.8 pct ahead of censure motion.

text.p: Istanbul shares firmed in selective and range-bound trade on Tuesday, ahead of a censure motion debate against the Islamist-led coalition government which began in parliament, brokers said.

The IMKB National-100 closed at 1,641, up 13 points, or 0.8 percent from Monday, but down from an early high of 1,652. Trade volume leapt to 30.21 trillion lira ($249.3 million) from Monday's 20.62 trillion ($170.1 million).
"Trade became dull in the afternoon... The index faced resistance at 1,650," said Zeki Direk from Eczacibasi securities.
Brokers said the market would face resistance at 1,700, the all-time high closing reached on January 27, even if the vote results were positive.
Parliament began its debate on the censure motion filed by two leftist parties after the market closed.
"The market will set direction depending on the results of the vote," said dealer Koray Cervatoglu.
The main opposition conservative Motherland Party put forward another censure motion, expected to be heard next week.
